title: Scalable Energy Management & Real-Time Telemetry Platform
subtitle: High-throughput distributed backend built with Java and Spring Boot
summary: A high-performance fullstack platform designed for real-time sensor data ingestion, scalable processing, and intuitive energy telemetry visualization.
description: Architected for high scalability and real-time interaction in distributed environments. The system handles continuous data streams from remote energy nodes, processing inputs through optimized Java pipelines and persisting state with robust consistency guarantees. Features modular service separation, RESTful APIs, and responsive client monitoring.

impactMetrics.label: Processing Model
impactMetrics.description: Continuous data streaming with low-latency state synchronization.

impactMetrics.label: Architecture
impactMetrics.description: Independent backend service contracts for reliable scaling.

impactMetrics.label: Reliability
impactMetrics.description: Zero packet drop under sustained simulated data bursts.

title: Multithreaded Task Queue & Concurrency Management Engine
subtitle: High-throughput asynchronous task scheduler using Java concurrency primitives
summary: A core multithreaded queuing engine engineered to balance dynamic task loads across dedicated worker threads without bottlenecks or thread starvation.
description: Built to tackle asynchronous workload distribution and synchronization challenges in compute-heavy systems. Employs Java's concurrency utilities (thread pools, blocking queues, atomic operations) to dynamically allocate and execute bursty task streams. Features real-time queue depth monitoring, simulation modes, and deadlock-free synchronization.

impactMetrics.label: Throughput Gain
impactMetrics.description: Parallel thread execution compared to sequential queue processing.

impactMetrics.label: Thread Starvation
impactMetrics.description: Fair distribution algorithms prevent low-priority task starvation.

impactMetrics.label: Latency P99
impactMetrics.description: Sub-millisecond handoff across synchronized worker pools.

title: API Intercepts & Resilient UI Test Automation Harness
subtitle: Advanced Cypress test suite simulating edge-case network payloads and backend failures
summary: A robust frontend test automation harness utilizing Cypress cy.intercept() to validate client-side fault tolerance against faulty or degraded APIs.
description: Created to verify that modern web applications gracefully handle backend chaos. By intercepting HTTP network traffic and dynamically injecting custom HTTP status codes (404, 500, 503), malformed JSON, and synthetic network latency, the suite ensures UI interfaces display proper user-friendly fallbacks without unhandled exceptions or broken layouts.

impactMetrics.label: Edge Case Coverage
impactMetrics.description: All critical HTTP error scenarios and timeout states verified.

impactMetrics.label: Regression Speed
impactMetrics.description: Fast headless test execution integrated into development workflows.

impactMetrics.label: UI Crash Prevention
impactMetrics.description: Ensures clean toast/modal feedback on every network failure.

title: Native Hardware Benchmarking & Thermal Telemetry Suite
subtitle: Low-level C++ benchmarking utility measuring CPU throughput, network latency, and SSD I/O
summary: A high-precision native C++ systems utility engineered to measure raw CPU computing limits, network roundtrip times, and disk read/write throughput.
description: Developed out of a deep passion for hardware health and thermal performance. The application executes synthetic workloads across processor cores while gathering telemetry on memory throughput, network responsiveness, and drive I/O. Directly informs the hardware maintenance and on-the-spot thermal stress testing provided on the Cluj tech repair floor.

impactMetrics.label: Measurement Accuracy
impactMetrics.description: Direct kernel and hardware timer calls for low-overhead sampling.

impactMetrics.label: Subsystem Coverage
impactMetrics.description: Holistic stress profiling across primary system bottlenecks.

impactMetrics.label: Thermal Verification
impactMetrics.description: Powers real-world before/after validation on laptop cooling overhauls.
